reasons: The cited clauses support the compliant classification: Section 10.5 selects internal New York law (and bars amendment to any other governing law), and Section 10.6 submits the parties to the S.D.N.Y. and New York State courts sitting in New York, New York — the playbook's preferred New York law/New York venue.
Arbitration is elective under Article XI and any mediation/arbitration is seated in New York, New York (p0473), so there is no mandatory or foreign-seated arbitration triggering walk-away territory.
The redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment was raised, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic accepted-jurisdiction check also passes.
The nonexclusive (rather than exclusive) jurisdiction grant is correctly treated as a minor sub-element noted in the rationale, not a material deviation, and it preserves our optionality as customer.
